usedFor: Bluesky gains followers, and Google Docs logs each “New Follower on Account” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Follower on Account” in Bluesky, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: The trigger returns the follower's profile details, so the doc tab gets a readable record of who followed.

watchOut: Choosing replace instead of add in “Add or Replace Text In Tab” wipes the tab's existing log.
